title: JSON search freshness misses records without contentHash
description: Evidence: RecordMeta.contentHash is optional and createRecordMeta does not set it; packages/search/src/search-index.ts fingerprints records as [id, contentHash ?? ""]. Impact: on the JSON search path, content changes to imported/legacy records with no contentHash can leave stale search results marked fresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Search corpus fingerprint includes stable content-derived data when contentHash is absent, with a regression for changed text on records lacking contentHash.
